mapper.select: SELECT ddps.id, shares.dates, shares.pkg, shares.version, shares.config_group_type, shares.config_group_name, shares.invitation_num, shares.fill_code_num, shares.total_user_num, ddps.create_time, ddps.update_time from (SELECT dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, dusr.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name config_group_name, count(DISTINCT CASE dusr.source WHEN 1 THEN dusr.user_id END) invitation_num, count(DISTINCT CASE dusr.source WHEN 2 THEN dusr.user_id END) fill_code_num, COUNT(DISTINCT dusr.user_id) total_user_num FROM dwd_user_share_record dusr INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = dusr.user_id) WHERE dusr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, dusr.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name) shares LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_lab_share ddps on (ddps.dates = shares.dates and ddps.pkg = shares.pkg and ddps.version = shares.version and ddps.config_group_type = shares.config_group_type and ddps.config_group_name = shares.config_group_name)
